text:
jordan (infra): FYI perf alert - a few jobs in eu-west are hitting packet loss between nodes, GPUs dropping connections.
maria (sre): link to spike graph? 
jordan (infra): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/ua-az?orgId=1 : the 10:13-10:32 window shows tx retries and reorders on nodepool-eu-west-2b
sam (ml infra): are these RoCE flows? last week we saw similar symptoms with MTU mismatch
jordan (infra): Not pure RoCE, it's gRPC over TCP between workers but symptoms match fragmentation + drops. got pcap from node-3 -> shows a bunch of RSTs and out-of-order segments
lee (platform): any recent network policy changes? I merged the ns-labeling PR yesterday
jordan (infra): yes - I think the new release of our cluster isolation policy added a namespaceSelector that accidentally matched the gpu-tenant-* label. It denied egress to the overlay CIDR for intra-node VXLAN
deploy-bot: policy apply finished: network-policy/cluster-isolate @ 2026-03-18T10:09:12Z
maria (sre): can you show the policy snippet? paste the deny rule
jordan (infra): ```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: GlobalNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: cluster-isolate
spec:
  selector: "has(team)"
  types:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    destination:
      nets:
      - 0.0.0.0/0
  - action: Deny
    destination:
      selector: "has(cluster-external)"
  namespaceSelector: "has(gpu-tenant)"
``` 
maria (sre): oh — namespaceSelector on a GlobalNetworkPolicy is scoped badly, it matched gpu namespaces in other AZs. so pods lost VXLAN encapsulation path
sam (ml infra): that would create intra-cluster blackholes for pod->pod traffic across nodes, especially if the allow list only covered 0.0.0.0/0 but omitted overlay range
jordan (infra): workaround: annotated affected pods with `networking.redwood/egress-override: allow-internal` and added a short-lived policy to allow overlay CIDR 10.244.0.0/16 between gpu namespaces
lee (platform): commands used:
```
kubectl annotate ns gpu-team-a networking.redwood/egress-override=allow-internal
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: GlobalNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-overlay-gpu-temp
spec:
  selector: "has(gpu-tenant)"
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    destination:
      nets:
      - 10.244.0.0/16
  types:
  - Egress
EOF
```
maria (sre): After that packet loss dropped to baseline. We should revert the Global policy change and replace with a more targeted policy (namespace label + allow overlay)
sam (ml infra): Also checking if any MTU mismatch exacerbated it; ran ip link show on nodes, vxlan mtu was 1450 vs expected 8922 on one host — following up with infra to verify host NIC config
jordan (infra): action items:
- revert cluster-isolate global policy (lee)
- create targeted NetworkPolicy for control-plane egress only (maria)
- roll a canary of gpu namespaces with explicit overlay allow and monitor (sam)
- audit namespace labels to avoid accidental matches (jordan)
maria (sre): fyi i'll open an incident postmortem template and add graphs + pcap
lee (platform): done, policy reverted and canary applied, monitoring OK :thumbsup:
sam (ml infra): thanks — i'll watch job retries and report if any regressions
jordan (infra): thanks team, closing thread once postmortem is up :white_check_mark:
